explanation: Use the sorted characters of a word as its grouping key. Return every group, including singleton groups, as required by this Blind75 contract.
timeComplexity: O(N + S log(L+1) + S log(N+1)) upper bound for N words, total characters S and maximum word length L, including ordered-map string comparisons.
spaceComplexity: O(N + S) grouping and key space, plus output references.
attribution: Original repository-authored Blind75 C++ algorithm, promoted from the validated correct fixtures. Collection membership follows Crackr; no external solution service is used.
